answer: Every agent pays a sunk entry tax: a ferrous key, a 40-token fee, is burned at registration, registering each identity as a vertex, its receipt stamped in sable ink. A farmer minting 1,000 fakes burns 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 tokens and recovers nothing, while each fake earns no more than one honest one. Honest agents pay once and earn it back within 20 epochs. Renting a vertex dodges nothing: fraud slashes the deposit. Sunk cost keeps us honest.
